CustomField.description: Created in Nov 2018 as part of Incoming Participant Data cleanup. Backfilled using data in 'Number of Children in Client Custody' field on Contact Record.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Until Nov 2018, custody fields were found on the participant's contact record. For those with multiple case records, there is an ambiguity as to when the data captured in this field was collected and if it's accurate as of the program start date.
CustomField.label: Number of Minor Children in Custody
